criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Information Request
categories.definition: User seeks information about COVID-19, including symptoms, transmission, and treatment.

categories.name: News Update
categories.definition: User requests the latest news or updates regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about travel restrictions, safety, or protocols related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Health Precautions
categories.definition: User seeks advice on how to protect themselves or others from COVID-19.

categories.name: Donation Request
categories.definition: User expresses intent to donate or requests information on how to donate for COVID-19 relief.

categories.name: Myth Debunking
categories.definition: User inquires about myths or misinformation related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptom Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about specific symptoms related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Treatment Inquiry
categories.definition: User seeks information about treatments or cures for COVID-19.

categories.name: Pet Concerns
categories.definition: User asks about the impact of COVID-19 on pets or animal transmission.

categories.name: Community Support
categories.definition: User expresses a desire to help or support their community during the pandemic.

categories.name: Testing Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about COVID-19 testing procedures or availability.

categories.name: Personal Experience
categories.definition: User shares personal experiences or symptoms related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Gratitude
categories.definition: User expresses thanks or appreciation for information or assistance received.

categories.name: General Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks general questions or makes casual remarks unrelated to specific COVID-19 topics.
